# Streamline ABI headers

Source: https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline/tree/625db07/include
(Streamline SDK 2.14.16, released October 2026)

Only ABI declarations needed to observe the game's existing Streamline calls
are vendored. The original NVIDIA MIT notices remain in each header. No
Streamline binary is distributed or substituted by this port.
